question: Why do the two Aśvins bow to the goddess of rasa to remove the conception of time's divisions?
premises: The two Aśvins bow to the goddess of rasa.
Their aim is to lead away the conception of time and its divisions.
The goddess is the object of this reverence.
inference: Reverence to the goddess of rasa enables transcendence of temporal conception.
plain_english: To remove the conception of time and its divisions, the two Aśvins bow to the goddess of rasa.
